profile.Name: Grand Marshall Krug
profile.Job: Grand Marshall and leader of the Order of Chitrin
profile.Personality: A zealous commander who waves off outsiders but greets fellow believers warmly. He plans the Order's war with care and claims the Chronicles of Chitrin foretold events, even when he plainly did not see them coming.
profile.Backstory: He leads the Order of Chitrin from the Ancient Tech Lab in Shun and sends outsiders to Seneschal Rodrick. He means to purge the Okranites, Countess Basilisk's Narkoites, and Yoshinga's Inhuman Hunters, and to win back the promised lands his faith says were stolen from Chitrin's people. He sees the Shek Kingdom as a lesser threat, and the Holy Nation calls him the leader of blasphemous cowards.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Calls his god "the Great Father, Chitrin" and believers "holy brother". Dismisses outsiders with a curt "Be gone..." and preaches the tolerance of the many over the hubris of the few.
